_comment: Regulatory-activity datasets for the CEILING and transfer arms. Every URL in this file was verified to resolve before being recorded. 'sequences_included' is the field that decides usability: a dataset distributing only coordinates or counts cannot drive a physics head without a separate genome lift.

datasets.name: lentimpra
datasets.title: lentiMPRA, ENCODE4 (K562, HepG2, WTC11)
datasets.citation: Agarwal V, Inoue F, Schubach M, Penzar D, et al. Nature 639:411-420 (2025). doi:10.1038/s41586-024-08430-9
datasets.license: MIT (human_legnet repackaging of the authors' data)
datasets.element_note: 15 nt 5' adaptor + 200 nt element + 15 nt 3' adaptor

datasets.name: deepstarr
datasets.title: DeepSTARR UMI-STARR-seq, Drosophila S2
datasets.citation: de Almeida BP, Reiter F, Pagani M, Stark A. Nat Genet 54:613-624 (2022). doi:10.1038/s41588-022-01048-5
datasets.columns: activity TSV has 6 unnamed numeric columns: Dev_log2_enrichment, Hk_log2_enrichment, then scaled and quantile-normalised variants
datasets.join_warning: FASTA and activity files join BY ROW ORDER, not by a key. Verify record counts match before pairing.

datasets.name: jores_plant
datasets.title: Jores plant core-promoter STARR-seq (Arabidopsis, maize, sorghum)
datasets.citation: Jores T, Tonnies J, Wrightsman T, Buckler ES, Cuperus JT, Fields S, Queitsch C. Nature Plants 7:842-855 (2021). doi:10.1038/s41477-021-00932-y
datasets.license: NONE DECLARED in the repository; cite the paper, no explicit redistribution grant
datasets.activity: log2 enrichment relative to the 35S minimal promoter
datasets.columns: set, sp, gene, sequence, enrichment; sp in {At, Zm, Sb}
datasets.caveat: The CNN splits cover only the with-enhancer, dark condition. All six conditions require Supplementary Tables 1 and 2.

datasets.name: yeast_promoter
datasets.title: Yeast random promoter expression library (DREAM release)
datasets.citation: Vaishnav ED, de Boer CG, et al. Nature 603:455-463 (2022). doi:10.1038/s41586-022-04506-6
datasets.element_note: 17 nt prefix TGCATTTTTTTCACATC + 80 bp random region + 13 nt suffix GGTTACGGCTGTT; about 78 percent are exactly 110 bp, so filter on length
datasets.activity: train: FACS bin scale 0-17. test: MAUDE score, roughly -1.4 to 1.7
datasets.caveat: test_sequences.txt from the challenge has nan for every label; use the MAUDE file instead.

datasets.name: sharpr_mpra
datasets.title: Sharpr-MPRA tiled MPRA (K562, HepG2)
datasets.citation: Ernst J, Melnikov A, Zhang X, Wang L, Rogov P, Mikkelsen TS, Kellis M. Nat Biotechnol 34:1180-1190 (2016). doi:10.1038/nbt.3678
datasets.activity: per-base SHARPR score, 295 positions per region
datasets.columns: sequences: 2 columns, ID CELLTYPE_STATE_REGIONID_TILEPOS_CHR_CENTER and 145 bp tile; scores: 295 per-base values per region

datasets.name: splice_sites
datasets.title: Splice site recognition, the negative control task
datasets.citation: SpliceFinder: Wang R, Wang Z, Wang J, Li S. BMC Bioinformatics 20:652 (2019). doi:10.1186/s12859-019-3306-3; packaged by InstaDeep for the Nucleotide Transformer benchmark
datasets.license: parent repository is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; treat as non-commercial
datasets.columns: FASTA with header >Seq_<i>|<label>; junction at index 200
datasets.label_warning: Label mapping is undocumented upstream and was determined empirically from centre dinucleotides: 0=acceptor (AG at 198-199), 1=donor (GT at 200-201), 2=neither. Re-verify before use.
